item.title: Ponys multilingual AI character consistency benchmark: preregistered test instrument
item.description: A preregistered 140-case instrument with three clean-session runs planned per case. Results have not been collected. First-party research, not an independent ranking. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22172094
